A Dragonfly Vinyasa class indicates mindful movement with breath. 
Every instructor has their own style. We all move around the mat mindfully - with intention. We focus on balance, strength, flexibility, awareness, alignment, breath, and cultivating the calm.
The studio is heated to 75-80 degrees; varies by instructor.
All levels welcome.

This class requires that you have been to a minimum of 3 Pilates FUNdamentals before.

Join Daniella for a SoundBath and you will be bathed in hypnotic, relaxing sounds that will help you enter a deeply relaxed state where you can release stress.

Lay in savasana for an hour while Daniella plays her beautiful soundscape of crystal bowls and gongs, adding her gorgeous vocal toning. 

You may experience a night of deep regenerative sleep after the sound bath ...  the frequency waves affect the body on a cellular level. 
It’s a great way to release tension and set a new positive course for your mind and body.

Dragonfly will provide a bolster and a blanket.
Only 30 spots available. 
$40 for 60 min of Sound Bathing

Aware & Ready is a 90-minute women's personal safety workshop designed to build everyday awareness, calm decision-making under pressure, and the quiet confidence that stays with you long after the session ends.

Not a typical martial arts class, but you will leave with real tools, both mental and physical, that you can use immediately… at work, commuting, and in everyday life.
